answer: Every new agent must lock a refundable admission deposit before it can attest or grade. That deposit is the economic anchor: it equals ten hours of the current median mining fee and stays frozen until the first epoch answer is countersigned by five established peers over a four-hour cooling window. If one funding source opens many keys, those deposits are capped as a group, so a plume of correlated joins cannot cheaply split the stake. Copied or empty answers forfeit a rising fraction of the lock, making a disposable lotus of throwaway names costlier than honest work.
